items.title: Robinhood Sinks 6% for a Second Day, Circle Down 5%, Affirm Down 5% as Fintech Stocks Slide
items.summary: Key TakeawaysRobinhood shares fell 6% today, a second straight drop, as Circle and Affirm slid with the market and Bitcoin. Monday’s drop followed a report that Kalshi plans to offer stock trading, and nine senators are pushing back on a CFTC move to loosen state limits on prediction markets.

items.title: Former Robinhood employee pleads guilty in insider trading case
